summary: Vilas County, WI tower listed by the FFLA as gone at 46.10659, -89.71434; no source read gives its builder, date, design or what remains today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date or description of the site found in the sources read

evidence.supports: tower is in Vilas County, Wisconsin
listed as gone at 46.10659, -89.71434 in Vilas County

notes_for_editor: The story is under the 120-word floor because the evidence is thin. The Forest Lookouts Boulder page has only a heading and 'Wisconsin - Vilas County' in the cached copy, with no history. The only other pages I found were not about this tower: the WHS record HI234019 is Muskellunge Tower on Plum Firetower Rd in Boulder Junction (built 1934), a different tower, and must not be merged with this one. A Boulder Junction Public Library event page and a Manitowish Waters Historical Society post mention foundations of two early fire towers (1912 and early 1930s) on DNR land in Boulder Junction, but neither names which towers they were, so they are not linked here. The WJFW article on those foundations returned HTTP 429 twice and was not read. The OSM node 353894360 and data/sources/osm.json label the point 'standing', which is only map presence and conflicts with the FFLA 'Gone' entry; not used. Worth a retry for the WJFW article and the Historical Society's own write-up before any expansion.
